name: Zichis Agro-Allied Industries Plc
source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) audited annual report for the year ended 31 December 2025, cash flow statement
note: Whole Naira, audited FY2025 with the FY2024 comparative as printed. Operating cash flow, the net change for the year and the cash balances are the report own printed subtotals. The report groups the cost of listing and restructuring (42,123,820) and the purchase of fixed assets (68,332,600) under its cash flow from financing heading and prints tax paid (1,556,366) under cash flow from investing, so those two sections are presented here as the report groups them; operating plus investing plus financing equals the printed net cash flow for the year in both years, and the printed cash balance at the start of each year plus the net change equals the printed closing balance.
